title: grastidium aromaticum
intro: Grastidium aromaticum, commonly known as sweet cicely, is a biennial or perennial plant in the family Apiaceae. The health benefits of sweet cicely include its potential to help in digestion, alleviate symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome, and act as a natural sweetener due to its sweet, anise-like flavor. The therapeutic actions of sweet cicely are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve nausea and gas, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Grastidium aromaticum include volatile oils, flavonoids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
